toolSpec.name: extract_deviation_info
toolSpec.description: Extract deviation investigation information from documents

title.description: Title or heading of the deviation exactly as it appears in the document

description.description: Full description of the deviation exactly as it appears in the document

immediate_steps_taken.description: Complete text of immediate corrective steps taken exactly as it appears in the document

quality_risk_evaluation.description: Quality risk evaluation or classification rationale text exactly as it appears in the document

investigation_summary.description: Complete investigation details or summary text exactly as it appears in the document

capa_plan.description: Complete CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) plan or CAPA overview text exactly as it appears in the document

recurrence_check_details.description: Recurrence check details or monitoring information exactly as it appears in the document

effectiveness_check_plan.description: Effectiveness check plan text exactly as it appears in the document
